We need correlate OTDR events. From site A, distances measured along fibre with launch/receive cords 1 km. OTDR distances given are fibre distances from ODF at shooting site? Note: Distances are fibre distances from ODF at shooting site. Launch and receive cords of 1.000 km were used; receive cord ends in open connector.

Event 1 at -0.001 km reflective loss 2.69 dB. That's likely launch connector? The negative distance suggests start.

Event 2 at 3.932 km non-reflective loss 0.1 dB. That's near SC-01 at 3.84 km. Slight offset due to fibre excess.

Event 3 at 6.848 km non-reflective loss -0.91 dB. That's negative loss = gain. Should be near SC-02 at 6.647 km. -0.91 dB loss suggests maybe a macrobend causing loss? Wait negative loss is gain, unusual. Could be OTDR artifact due to reflective event? Could be splice gain due to measurement? Hmm.

Event 4 at 9.628 km loss 0.3 dB, near SC-03 at 9.323 km.

Event 5 at 16.977 km reflective loss 0.24 dB, reflectance -50.8 dB. That's likely B-ODF connector? Distance from A: 16.977 km fibre distance, as-built route 16.49 km. Difference ~0.5 km due to excess fibre. Reflective event at B-ODF.

Event 6 at 17.98 km end.

From site B OTDR:

Event 1 at 0.001 km reflective loss 0.27 dB, reflectance -51.4 dB. That's B-ODF? Possibly near start.

Event 2 at 2.242 km non-reflective loss 0.05 dB. That corresponds to distance from B towards A: 2.242 km. So from A it's 16.49-2.242=14.248 km, near SC-04 at 14.308 km. Good.

Event 3 at 7.352 km loss -0.26 dB. From A: 16.49-7.352=9.138 km, near SC-03 at 9.323 km. Negative loss again.

Event 4 at 10.125 km loss 0.98 dB. From A: 16.49-10.125=6.365 km, near SC-02 at 6.647 km. Loss 0.98 dB is significant.

Event 5 at 13.047 km loss 0.05 dB. From A: 16.49-13.047=3.443 km, near SC-01 at 3.84 km. Slight offset.

Event 6 at 16.977 km reflective loss 2.69 dB, reflectance -29.4 dB. That's A-ODF connector? Distance from B 16.977 km matches fibre length. Reflective loss 2.69 dB at A-ODF? Actually event 1 from A showed -0.001 km reflective loss 2.69 dB. So this is reciprocal.

So we have a loss event at ~6.4 km from A (10.125 km from B) with 0.98 dB loss. That's close to SC-02 at 6.647 km. The OTDR from A at 6.848 km shows -0.91 dB loss (gain). Hmm inconsistency.

checklist.item: Run embedded OTDR from site A in-service
checklist.note: OTDR A shows event at 3.932 km non-reflective loss 0.1 dB, event 3.932 km matches SC-01 at 3.84 km. Event at 6.848 km non-reflective loss -0.91 dB gain, event at 9.628 km loss 0.3 dB, end ~18 km.

checklist.item: Run embedded OTDR from site B in-service
checklist.note: OTDR B shows event at 10.125 km non-reflective loss 0.98 dB. From B towards A, 10.125 km corresponds to 16.49-10.125=6.365 km from A, near SC-02 at 6.647 km. Event at 7.352 km from B (9.138 km from A) shows -0.26 dB gain, maybe SC-03 region.

checklist.item: Correlate OTDR events with link record elements and route km
checklist.note: OTDR A shows reflective event at start with loss 2.69 dB reflectance -27.8 dB at A-ODF. OTDR B confirms same connector at 16.977 km from B with loss 2.69 dB reflectance -29.4 dB. Event correlates with A-ODF. SC-02 shows 0.98 dB loss from B but -0.91 dB from A, likely measurement artifact; primary lo

checklist.item: Determine root cause fault type, location and corrective action
checklist.note: Root cause identified as damaged connector at A-ODF causing ~2.7 dB excess loss, matching RX drop ~2.4 dB after patching work 24 Oct, cleaning ineffective.

args.evidence: RX power dropped ~2.4 dB after site A ODF patching on 2026-10-24 08:14 and cleaning did not restore it. Embedded OTDR from A shows reflective event at start with loss 2.69 dB reflectance -27.8 dB; OTDR from B confirms same 2.69 dB loss at 16.977 km from B, matching A-ODF. TX power remained stable at ~2.1 dBm, BER degraded, consistent with connector damage not transmitter.
